subject: Clarify self-booked on-prem demo time + pre-demo evidence request
messages:
From: Blake Turner <blake.turner@medsecure.co>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-07T17:15:00Z
Subject: Self-booked demo confirmation — Private / On‑prem

Hi Chloe,

I used the self-serve flow on your site and booked a demo for September 8th at 10:00 (it showed up in my calendar). We're evaluating a private/on‑prem deployment for regulated workloads and need the call to cover tenant isolation, VPC peering options, and data residency.

Attendees: Blake Turner (IT Security), Priya Sharma (Cloud Ops)

Also — before the demo we need to review your SOC 2 report and a network diagram to send to our procurement and security teams. I attached our network diagram to this email. Please confirm the demo time and share any pre-demo checklist.

Thanks,
Blake
(Blake Turner)
IT Security — MedSecure Health

Attachment: Medsecure_network_diagram.pdf

From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: Blake Turner <blake.turner@medsecure.co>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-07T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Self-booked demo confirmation — Private / On‑prem

Hi Blake — thanks for booking and for the network diagram. Quick heads up: it looks like the self-booked slot may have been created in PDT which is why calendars sometimes show a different time for EU teams. Can you confirm the timezone you intended (BST/CEST/UTC)?

To make sure the call is useful for your security and procurement reviewers, can you please: 
- Confirm the desired demo window in BST (we have availability next week 9–11 Sep, 14:00–17:00 BST).
- Confirm whether you need an audited SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary (procurement usually asks for Type II).
- Share any specific evidence points (e.g., encryption at rest keys, key-management responsibilities, audit log retention).

I've CC'd Priyom (AE) and Aditya (SE) so they can prep the on‑prem/tenant-isolation portion. I'll also send our pre-demo checklist and an NDA link (DocuSign) if you'd like a redlined NDA before we discuss infra details.

I'll propose a couple of slots once you confirm timezone.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior SDR — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_pre-demo_checklist.pdf

From: Blake Turner <blake.turner@medsecure.co>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.sharma@medsecure.co
Date: 2027-09-07T19:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Self-booked demo confirmation — Private / On‑prem

Hi Chloe — thanks for the quick reply. Apologies — my team is in the UK so I meant 09 Sep at 15:00 BST (the self‑serve widget defaulted to my browser timezone which is why the booking showed as PDT for some attendees).

We need SOC 2 Type II. I shared the network diagram (attached) and flagged that we require evidence around: KMS integration, audit log export, and data residency controls (EU-only).

If you can send the NDA link we'll get that signed before the call. Confirmed attendees: Blake Turner (security), Priya Sharma (cloud ops), and our procurement lead may join pending availability.

Thanks — Blake

Attachment: Medsecure_network_diagram.pdf (resent)

From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: Blake Turner <blake.turner@medsecure.co>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-07T20:05:00Z
Subject: Confirmed: 2027-09-09 15:00 BST — Private deployment demo + pre-demo items

Thanks Blake — confirmed for 09 Sep at 15:00 BST. I've created the calendar invite and shared a DocuSign NDA link here: https://na1.docusign.com/NDAs/abcdef123456 — if you could sign that and reply with a preferred procurement contact, we'll loop them into the invite.

What we'll cover on the call:
- Tenant isolation and VPC options for on‑prem deployments
- KMS integrations and encryption at rest (how key ownership can be configured)
- Audit logs, retention, and export options for compliance
- Deployment topologies for EU-only data residency

Prep requested from your side: SOC 2 Type II (or pointer to where we can access it), network diagram (got it), and any procurement questions to prioritize.

Priyom/aditya/mina — action items before the demo:
- Aditya: prepare a short architecture walkthrough showing air‑gapped and VPC peering options; include quantization/cost notes for on‑prems.
- Mina: please prepare a short summary of what evidence we can share (SOC 2, penetration testing cadence, audit log retention windows).
- Priyom: prepare procurement checklist and typical timelines for Dedicated/Private contracts.

I'll update the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890 and attach the signed NDA there when it's returned.

Best,
Chloe

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-07T20:20:00Z
Subject: Internal: Prep notes for MedSecure demo (09 Sep 15:00 BST)

Quick internal plan: 
- Aditya: demo flow should start with high-level tenant isolation patterns → deep dive on network flows and peering → show KMS options (cust-managed vs RW-managed). Bring one on‑prem topology slide and one VPC peering diagram.
- Mina: prepare a one‑pager we can drop in the call chat covering SOC 2 artifacts we can share and the process for custom evidence requests (timelines).
- I'll prepare procurement slide listing contract terms, typical commit sizes for Private, and lead time for Dedicated capacity.

Also flag: prospect asked specifically about EU-only data residency. Aditya, confirm whether we can demo region pinning and where audit logs are stored for Private customers.

Thanks — Priyom

From: Blake Turner <blake.turner@medsecure.co>

Thanks Chloe — NDA signed and returned via DocuSign. Our procurement contact is liam.jones@medsecure.co; please include him on the invite. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Blake
